noWallet: No Arweave wallet is set up on this computer. Generate or import one in the Arweave tab, add some AR, then try again.
insufficientBalance: The Arweave wallet does not have enough AR: this upload needs {{needed}} AR and the wallet has {{has}} AR. Deposit AR into the wallet and try again.
nothingToPublish: There is nothing to publish yet — add at least one entry to the vault first.
network: Could not reach the Arweave network. Check your internet connection and try again. ({{raw}})
reverted: The transaction was mined but reverted on-chain, so the vault on-chain was not updated.
notConfirmedYet: The transaction was sent but not confirmed in time. It may still confirm in a minute — check before sending again.
